delivered.statement: Q1 revenue ₹72,275 crore: +2.2% QoQ, +13.9% YoY; $7,624M flat QoQ, +2.7% YoY
Annualized AI services revenue reached $2.6 billion, up 13.6% QoQ
Delivered TCV of $9.5 billion; 6th mega deal win in 5 quarters ($800M SKF)
Operating margin 24% (down 130 bps from wage hikes 170 bps offset by 40 bps currency)
Net margin 19.2%; DSO at 74 days; cash conversion 93% of net income
Workforce 593,798; onboarded 14,000 campus graduates; 14.6M learning hours logged
Announced global partnership with Anthropic (50k Claude licenses); became Mistral first GSI
Maintained healthy client additions across $10M+, $5M+, $1M+ revenue bands sequentially

themes: AI-led transformation driving mega deals and accelerating revenue monetization
Geopolitical uncertainties causing project deferrals in consumer and manufacturing
Sovereign cloud and compliance demand from governments and regulated enterprises
Agentic AI deployed across IT-ops, business processes yielding measurable productivity gains
Strategic partnerships with frontier AI (Anthropic, Mistral) enabling innovation
Infrastructure to Intelligence strategy positioning TCS for AI adoption cycle
risks: Geopolitical conflicts continuing to cause project deferrals and demand hesitation
Consumer and manufacturing segments weak; airlines and auto sectors under pressure
AI project revenue lumpiness due to non-recurring, one-off deal nature
Client cost management on AI tokens becoming critical; model FinOps emerging priority

analyst_pushback.pushback: Can you quantify macro/geopolitical impact on Q1 demand?
analyst_pushback.response: Can't quantify rate of change; seeing stronger uptick in some verticals giving confidence

analyst_pushback.pushback: What percentage of business absorbed AI productivity pass-through?
analyst_pushback.response: Difficult to quantify; typically 10-15% productivity pass-through, often offset by additional work

analyst_pushback.pushback: Why AI revenue incremental fell to $75M from $125M prior quarter?
analyst_pushback.response: AI projects non-recurring, two-quarter max; lumpiness expected quarter-to-quarter despite overall growth

analyst_pushback.pushback: Why hire and raise wages if AI eliminates white-collar jobs?
analyst_pushback.response: Disagree with job reduction view; people perform different roles (prompt engineering, model training)

tone_evidence: Confident on AI positioning and long-term strategy; cautious on near-term demand from geopolitical impacts; defensive on employment narrative
